dimensions.note: Pure data shaping over workflow artifacts; the report holds no credentials and makes no authenticated calls.
Structured placeholders via the never-throws tryLog wrapper; the new failed-attempts path adds a structured warn when auditTimeline.failedAttempts fails schema validation.
failedAttempts config is safeParse-validated; an invalid section disables the feature with a warning instead of throwing. Per-artifact narrow catches and the outer degrade contract are unchanged.

19 tests: prior coverage plus statusPartition boundaries (399/400, absent, non-numeric), dataset routing by step name, roster/SQL inclusion of rejected primary rows and exclusion of dataset rows, None-found rendering, and section omission without config.
Read-only and deterministic for the same artifacts; re-runs are safe.
No external HTTP calls; artifact shapes are validated with zod safeParse before use.
No connections, file handles, temp files, or cloud resources.
Placeholders only: widgets-theme operation names, generic step names (query-failed-graphql / query-failed-xyz), RFC 5737 IPs, neutral families.
